nonrec theorem two_lt_card_iff : 2 < card α ↔ ∃ a b c : α, a ≠ b ∧ a ≠ c ∧ b ≠ c := by
  simp_rw [← Finset.card_univ, two_lt_card_iff, mem_univ, true_and]

@[simp]
theorem birthday_star : birthday ⟦PGame.star⟧ = 1 := by
  apply le_antisymm
  · rw [← PGame.birthday_star]
    exact birthday_quot_le_pGameBirthday  _
  · rw [Ordinal.one_le_iff_ne_zero, ne_eq, birthday_eq_zero, Game.zero_def,
      ← PGame.equiv_iff_game_eq]
    exact PGame.star_fuzzy_zero.not_equiv

--src: Mathlib.SetTheory.Ordinal.Notation
theorem fastGrowingε₀_two : fastGrowingε₀ 2 = 2048 := by
  norm_num [fastGrowingε₀, show oadd 0 1 0 = 1 from rfl, @fastGrowing_limit (oadd 1 1 0) _ rfl,
    show oadd 0 (2 : Nat).succPNat 0 = 3 from rfl, @fastGrowing_succ 3 2 rfl]

--src: Mathlib.SetTheory.Game.Birthday
@[simp]
theorem birthday_zero : birthday 0 = 0 := by
  rw [← Ordinal.le_zero, ← PGame.birthday_zero]
  exact birthday_quot_le_pGameBirthday  _

--src: Mathlib.Deprecated.Cardinal.Finite
theorem one_lt_card_iff_nontrivial (α : Type*) : 1 < card α ↔ Nontrivial α := by
  rw [← Cardinal.one_lt_iff_nontrivial]
  conv_rhs => rw [← Nat.cast_one]
  rw [← natCast_lt_toPartENat_iff]
  simp only [PartENat.card, Nat.cast_one]

--src: Mathlib.NumberTheory.LegendreSymbol.Basic
/-- Euler's Criterion: A unit `x` of `ZMod p` is a square if and only if `x ^ (p / 2) = 1`. -/
theorem euler_criterion_units (x : (ZMod p)ˣ) : (∃ y : (ZMod p)ˣ, y ^ 2 = x) ↔ x ^ (p / 2) = 1 := by
  by_cases hc : p = 2
  · subst hc
    simp only [eq_iff_true_of_subsingleton, exists_const]
  · have h₀ := FiniteField.unit_isSquare_iff (by rwa [ringChar_zmod_n]) x
    have hs : (∃ y : (ZMod p)ˣ, y ^ 2 = x) ↔ IsSquare x := by
      rw [isSquare_iff_exists_sq x]
      simp_rw [eq_comm]
    rw [hs]
    rwa [card p] at h₀

--src: Mathlib.Data.PNat.Find
theorem find_eq_iff : PNat.find h = m ↔ p m ∧ ∀ n < m, ¬p n := by
  constructor
  · rintro rfl
    exact ⟨PNat.find_spec h, fun _ => PNat.find_min h⟩
  · rintro ⟨hm, hlt⟩
    exact le_antisymm (PNat.find_min' h hm) (not_lt.1 <| imp_not_comm.1 (hlt _) <| PNat.find_spec h)

--src: Mathlib.Data.Nat.Totient
@[simp]
theorem totient_two : φ 2 = 1 :=
  (totient_prime prime_two).trans rfl
